title: Presentation of the fppf quotient stack of an algebraic-space groupoid
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and $U,R$ algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Write $h_U,h_R$ for their underlying presheaves. Suppose natural transformations $s,t:h_R\to h_U$, $e:h_U\to h_R$, $i:h_R\to h_R$, and $c:h_R\times_{s,h_U,t}h_R\to h_R$ satisfy the test-scheme groupoid laws [def-sfb-algebraic-space-groupoid], with $c(q,r)=q\circ r$. Let $F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and $a:h_U\to F$ a functor over that base, using the discrete fibred-groupoid and vertical 2-isomorphism conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. A quotient presentation consists of the following data and properties: $F$ is an fppf stack [def-sfb-fppf-stackification]; a vertical natural isomorphism $\eta:a\circ s\cong a\circ t$; for every test scheme $T/S$, points $x,y\in U(T)$, and vertical arrow $\beta:a(x)\to a(y)$, there is exactly one $r\in R(T)$ with $s(r)=x$, $t(r)=y$ and $\eta_r=\beta$, after transporting by the endpoint equalities; every object $z$ of $F$ over $T$ has a covering sieve $V$ in the big fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site] such that for every $f:T'\to T$ in $V$ there are $x\in U(T')$ and an arrow $a(x)\to z$ over $f$; and $\eta_r$ followed by $\eta_q$ equals $\eta_{c(q,r)}$ for every composable pair. These conditions express that $F$ with this map and arrow comparison is the fppf stackification $[U/R]$; no stackification object, atlas or groupoid flatness is chosen.
